role: Director, New Mexico Department of Game and Fish
summary: Ladd S. Gordon, Director of the New Mexico Department of Game and Fish, endorses the implementation of Executive Order 11644, stating it should be beneficial to wildlife. He notes the department's long-standing concern about ORV impacts on hunting, fishing, and wildlife disturbance, and expresses support for applying federal ORV guidelines to state lands. He also outlines several existing state regulations and enforcement actions his department has taken to restrict off-road vehicle use.

statement.opening_anchor:
Dear David:

We have reviewed the Draft Environmental Statement prepared by the Bureau of Outdoor Recreation, Department of the Interior, proposing Department implementation of Executive Order 11644
statement.closing_anchor:
We have worked closely with the Forest Service, Bureau of Land Management and local livestock boards to discourage off-road vehicle use, primarily through publicity.

Very truly yours,
Ladd S. Gordon
Director

summary_quote: We endorse the implementation of Executive Order 11644 as it should be beneficial to wildlife.
